content.comment_body: Hello, I am experiencing an issue with the new [product_name]. After installing it and loading a program created in [product_name] [version_no], when I navigate to the address 198.162.xx, I am presented with a page about [product_name] licenses. I am unsure how to confirm and proceed to access the management page to control the [product_name] from my mobile device.
Hello, is there any update regarding this issue? I am experiencing the same problem. Thank you.

In the program properties of [product_name], you should: Allow access for [version_no]. Then, navigate to Tools > Transfer > Access Control and enable the following: - Allow access for [product_name] & [product_name] - Allow Web Server access.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing challenges accessing the main management page for their [product_name] via the web interface after uploading a program from [product_name] [version_no]. Instead of reaching the expected control interface, users are redirected to a licenses page and are unsure how to continue to manage their device from a mobile device. The root cause seems related to access control settings for web server and [product_name] features.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect simple and direct access to manage their [product_name] through a mobile web interface, without encountering unexpected license confirmation processes.
